reproduction.expected: Every persisted starter-host-session@1 is closed, integrity-bound, and reconstructed from canonical session/runtime state; external and Human Gate resumes are proven through the orchestrator; interrupted STARTING or RESUMING transitions have a safe evidence-driven reconciliation path.
reproduction.actual: A persisted next_action can be changed to AUTOMATIC_MERGE with automatic_merge=true and StarterHostOrchestrator.read() returns it without rejection. The focused suite projects external/Human states but does not execute either resume through the orchestrator, and transitional crash states have no reconciliation API.

violated_invariants: Persisted Host next_action and policy cannot be accepted from mutable storage as live authority.
Session tampering and schema drift must fail closed before a Host receives an action.
External-event and Human-Gate resume ordering must be proven at the composed Host-session boundary.
A durable claimed transition must have an explicit reconciliation path that never blindly replays an ambiguous effect.
